title: Machine Learning for Tabular Data — Summary & Enhancements
summary: An educational Jupyter notebook that summarizes and extends code examples from the O'Reilly book 'Machine Learning for Tabular Data,' exploring classical and deep learning pipelines for structured/tabular data. It runs SDV's TVAESynthesizer (via sdv.single_table) with a SingleTableMetadata object to fit a VAE-based synthesizer and sample synthetic rows.
evidence: extra_Synthetic_Data.ipynb:417 - synthesizer = TVAESynthesizer(metadata, epochs=10000...); synthesizer.fit(df); synthesizer.sample(num_rows=10000)
